LanguageData.LP_Leather_WinterWolf.label: winter wolf pelt
LanguageData.LP_Leather_WinterWolf.description: The thick pale blue-grey pelt of a winter wolf, with frost seemingly hanging on the tips. Warmer than arctic wolf pelt and just as hard to pierce. Obtained by butchering winter wolves.
LanguageData.LP_StormOrb.label: storm orb
LanguageData.LP_StormOrb.description: A crystal ball sealing a thundercloud, its lightning never still. Anyone can crush it: the weather on the current map turns to thunderstorm for 1 day (without calling down lightning strikes). Made at the alchemy table from 2 planar residue and 10 gold.
LanguageData.LP_SkyAmber.label: sky amber
LanguageData.LP_SkyAmber.description: Amber that only forms high in the sky outside cloud castles, sealing a wisp of flowing cloud inside. Cloud giants treasure it as an heirloom, and it looks lovely in a room (beauty +15). Only sold by the league's cloud giant luxury caravans.
